newsitem.title: INDIA: Low consumer demand drives down India sugar prices.
newsitem.headline: Low consumer demand drives down India sugar prices.

text.p: Low consumer demand and increasing arrivals hurt Indian sugar on Monday with prices showing noticeable falls, dealers said.
More availability of sugar through public marketing channels also led to lower market offtake, they said.
"Arrivals today improved due to a stoppage of rain in producing centres and availability of trucks to carry sugar from the mills to markets," one broker said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 10/22 rupees to 1,240/1,268 rupees. M-30 slid by five rupees to 1,270/1,325. Sugar mill delivery however rose by 10 to 1,160/1,180 rupees.
